t: Big Wipes Heavy-Duty Reusable Textured Cleaning Wipes provide a high-performance solution for removing tough industrial dirt from hands, tools, and surfaces. This pack of 240 heavy-duty wipes is ideal for busy plumbers, electricians, and mechanics on the job site. The dual-sided design features a textured scrub side to loosen stubborn grease and a smooth side to trap grime. Built with closed-cell fabric technology, these wipes contain bio-based organic solvents that easily dissolve paint, silicone, and adhesive. Infused with skin conditioners to protect hands, these machine washable wipes can be recharged with Power Spray for re-use.
